title: Atlas setting descriptor
description: Declares an admin-editable runtime setting: its type, bounds, default, scope and sensitivity. The DESCRIPTOR ships with the code that reads the setting; only the VALUE is stored in the database. Studio generates the admin UI from these. Design: docs/architecture/configuration-and-reference-data.md §2.4. NOT bootstrap config (env/secrets) — that stays in service-kit.

key.description: Dotted key, unique within its area. Segments are lowerCamelCase, matching the TypeScript convention used across the codebase — e.g. `sweep.throughputMBps`.

area.description: Owning service or module — the row's owner (see design §4).

type.description: Value type. `duration` is ISO-8601 (P30D); `template` is a localized message template; `reference` points at a registry/vocabulary entry named by `refTarget`.

label.description: Human label for the generated admin UI; falls back to the key.

description.description: Help text rendered under the control.

group.description: Settings-page section this control is grouped under.

default.description: Value used when no row exists at any scope level. A system with an empty settings table MUST be fully operable.

required.description: True when there is no meaningful default and the deployment must supply a value.

scope.description: The DEEPEST level allowed to set this key. Resolution is nearest-wins: code default -> deployment -> channel -> category -> user (design §2.5).

pattern.description: Regex the string value must match.

options.description: Allowed values for `oneOf`/`manyOf`. These are CODE-KNOWN (Tier 0/1) choices — an admin-extensible list is a vocabulary instead, referenced via type `reference`.

refTarget.description: For type `reference`: the registry or vocabulary whose entries are selectable.

schema.description: For type `json`: an inline JSON Schema the value must validate against.

sensitive.description: Value is stored as a vault reference, redacted in API responses, masked in the UI, and shown only as `changed` in audit diffs.

restart.description: Change does not take effect until the owning service restarts; Studio warns and the service reports it as pending.

permission.description: Overrides the default `config:admin` grant required to write this key.

replacedBy.description: Key that supersedes this one; the migration runner copies the value and CI flags orphaned rows.

since.description: Release the setting was introduced in.

examples.label: Rejected-asset retention
examples.description: How long a rejected asset is kept before it is purged.
